title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
summary: Merge two sorted linked lists into one sorted list by reusing their nodes.
algorithmSteps: Create a dummy node and keep a tail pointer for the merged list.
Compare the two current nodes and append the smaller one.
Append the remaining list after one input is exhausted.

examples.explanation: The nodes from both sorted inputs are linked in ascending order.

edgeCases: Either input list may be empty.
The algorithm reuses existing nodes instead of allocating a new node per value.
